canDoWhy: Wujeeta, an Argonian who lodges at Haelga's Bunkhouse and works at the Riften Fishery, sets you on the trail of the city's skooma dealer.

starts.where: Riften: Haelga's Bunkhouse in the evening and at night, the Riften Fishery and its docks by day

firstStep: Find out who is dealing skooma in Riften

report Sarthis Idren to the Jarl of Riften
go in after Sarthis Idren and deal with him

choices.leadsTo: You report to whoever is Jarl of Riften at the time: Laila Law-Giver, or Maven Black-Briar if she holds the seat.

objectives: Report Sarthis Idren to the Jarl of Riften

rewards.what: Shipment's Ready (note), which names Cragslane Cavern as the skooma's source
rewards.when: found during the quest, as the source information

opens: Supply and Demand (the skooma source note points to Cragslane Cavern, and that quest begins by reporting the skooma source to the Jarl)

people.name: Wujeeta
people.role: gives the quest; lodges at Haelga's Bunkhouse and works at the Riften Fishery

people.name: Sarthis Idren
people.role: the skooma dealer; you deal with him in Riften Warehouse

people.name: Laila Law-Giver
people.role: Jarl of Riften you report to, when she rules; placed in Mistveil Keep

people.name: Maven Black-Briar
people.role: Jarl of Riften you report to, if she holds the seat

unsure.why: The dialogue conditions behind Wujeeta's line aren't in these files, so it isn't shown whether you must first help her with a healing potion (Helping Hand). Her late-night skooma habit only runs while Helping Hand is unfinished.

Wujeeta's day as read from her package names: asleep in Haelga's Bunkhouse from midnight to 6 am, on the fishery docks 6 to 9 am, inside the Riften Fishery 9 am to 3 pm, back on the docks 3 to 6 pm, then in the Bunkhouse from 6 pm.
Another mod in the list also edits this quest; what it changes isn't in these files.
The quest script pays gold, but the amount and who hands it over aren't in these files.
Sarthis Idren and a second quest person are spawned for the quest, so their exact spot isn't recorded; the warehouse is the only place the objectives name.
The link to Supply and Demand comes from the note's text and that quest's first objective, not from a record that starts it.
